verdict: Spend is live; leads are zero — the conversion path isn't ready yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $106.10 was spent across Meta and 211 clicks reached your site, but zero leads were generated because the landing pages and conversion tracking needed to capture those clicks are not yet in place. This is the central issue this period: ads are running before the infrastructure that turns a click into a lead exists. Nine planned milestones — including landing pages, tracking setup, and campaign lane launches — remain overdue from their July and August target dates, and getting those live is the immediate priority. We're accelerating delivery on those outstanding items now so that spend has somewhere to convert. Once the conversion path is in place, the click volume already being generated gives us a real baseline to work from.

watch_item.issue: Zero leads despite active ad spend — no conversion path exists yet, so clicks are not being captured as leads.
